sources.entry: Relaticle - CRM with an MCP server, an AI assistant with human-approved changes, a REST API, custom fields, and kanban boards. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Relaticle is a self-hosted, open-source CRM built on Laravel and Filament that AI agents can read and write to over MCP and a REST API.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a CRM web interface built with Filament 5 and Livewire 4, with an MCP server and REST API offering full CRUD, schema access, activity history, and pipeline analysis. Users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, or an open-source model over MCP to read, write, and analyze CRM data. Custom fields cover text, dates, currency, selects, and links between records, with per-field encryption and no migrations needed to add them. Data is workspace-scoped with role-based permissions and multi-workspace isolation. The README also mentions kanban boards and an AI assistant with human-approved changes, which come from the listing description rather than the README body.
use_cases: self-hosted CRM for a small sales team
let AI agents manage customer records via MCP
track deals on a pipeline or kanban board
add custom fields to contacts and companies without migrations
sell to a named list of companies without a sales team
integrate CRM data with other tools through a REST API
how_to_run: See the Self-Hosting Guide for Docker and manual deployment instructions.
notable: MCP server with full CRUD, schema access, and pipeline analysis for AI agents
Custom fields with per-field encryption and no migrations required
Self-hosted under AGPL-3.0 with Docker deployment guide
caveats: Requires PostgreSQL 17+, PHP 8.5+, and Node.js 22+, so setup is non-trivial
Redis is needed for queues outside development
English-only in the main repository; translation requires a fork and override workflow
